contradictions.what: Rep first says the trigger was the portal, then says the portal was an excuse and the real trigger was the new CFO's month-end close.
Rep says the customer was building a portal, then says Paul's team isn't building anything and the portal is off the shelf.
Rep says questions changed 'not much' after the bank call, then describes a new question about a named contact.
Rep says it was 'paperwork' after the ROI meeting, yet the reference request and branch card-reader question were still open and raised later.
Rep says the CFO insight came around the third call but says a month was lost; also the proposal stalled three weeks, so timing is loosely consistent but unclear.
Rep said 'Dead' at 20 percent before the data meeting, then 'paperwork' after; the shift rests on one meeting and rep estimates.
Rep says the branch capability was not demoed yet says Wen showed a slide and the customer let it go; evidence of resolution is only a slide.
